final_netlist:
.subckt dut vin vout vref vss ibias
* ---- bias: IREF sink diode, NMOS->PMOS mirror for level-shift current ----
MNB  ibias ibias vss vss nfet W=10 L=2
MN2  nbp   ibias vss vss nfet W=10 L=2
MPB  nbp   nbp   vin vin pfet W=10 L=2
MPS  refs  nbp   vin vin pfet W=10 L=2
* reference level shift: refs = vref + 10uA*30k = 0.9 V
RSH  refs  vref  30k
* ---- error amplifier (5T OTA, NMOS input) ----
MT   tail  ibias vss  vss nfet W=30  L=2
M1   d1    fb    tail vss nfet W=20 L=1
M2   gate  refs  tail vss nfet W=20 L=1
M3   d1    d1    vin  vin pfet W=10 L=1
M4   gate  d1    vin  vin pfet W=10 L=1
* ---- pass device ----
MP   vout  gate  vin  vin pfet W=2000 L=0.15
* ---- feedback divider: fb = 0.75*vout (= 0.9 V at 1.2 V) ----
R1   vout  fb    6000
R2a  fb    n1    6000
R2b  n1    n2    6000
R2c  n2    vss   6000
* ---- Miller compensation with nulling resistor ----
CC   gate  cz    1e-10
RZ   cz    vout  2000
.ends
